sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def psig(f):
    from collections import Counter
    rows=f.ascii.split('\n')
    cnt=Counter()
    for r in rows[10:48]:
        for ch in r:
            cnt[ch]+=1
    return dict(cnt)
base=psig(current_frame)
print('BASE', base)
targets=[('blue_sq',21,19),('gray_sq',31,9),('red_rect',31,14),('darkred_sq',31,19),
         ('checker',35,9),('greenblock',40,10),('red_mush',19,48),('blue_mush',36,48)]
for name,r,c in targets:
    res=action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':r,'col':c}])
    res=last_action_result
    cur=psig(current_frame)
    diff={k:(base.get(k,0),cur.get(k,0)) for k in set(base)|set(cur) if base.get(k,0)!=cur.get(k,0)}
    print(f"{name} ({r},{c}): reward={res.get('reward')} lvl={res.get('level_completed')} done={res.get('done')} noimpact={res.get('no_impact')} diff={diff}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
